# Vimokkhakathā (Ps 1.5)

**ID:** Ps 1.5
**Section:** Paṭisambhidāmagga (ps)
**Collection:** Sutta
**Title (Pali):** Vimokkhakathā
**tipitaka.org (CST):** https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/s0517m.mul0.xml

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Vimokkhakathā* ("Discussion of Liberation") is the fifth treatise of the *Paṭisambhidāmagga*, situated within its first major division (*Mahāvagga*) [Collins 1998]. Rather than using the term *vimokkha* ("liberation") solely as an experiential synonym for *nibbāna*, the treatise uses it as an expansive categorical term covering diverse occasions and processes of release [Collins 1998]. These include the successive meditative absorptions (*jhāna*s) and formless attainments culminating in cessation (*nirodhasamāpatti*), as well as the various stages of the supramundane paths and fruits [Collins 1998]. In comparative Buddhist studies, modern scholars have also traced doctrinal connections between the *Vimokkhakathā* and non-Theravāda literature, such as the *Mahāyāna Mahāparinirvāṇa-mahāsūtra* [Radich 2015].
